extracted.intended_audience: working sports media covering the Washington Redskins (reporters, photographers, broadcasters, online outlets)
extracted.subtask_description: Official media/PR guidelines for credentialing, media access, interview scheduling, practice and game-day operations for the Washington Redskins (2019). Includes priorities for credentials, rules for photographers, streaming, locker-room access, and procedural deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media portal / media guide access
rubrics_metrics.description: The Redskins’ Public Relations department has a media web-site (media.redskins.com) designed to serve the needs of all media members who cover the organization. The site contains the annual media guide and weekly game guides including stats, rosters, personnel bios and much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media can also access the media website by visiting Redskins.com and clicking on 'Media Guide' located at the bottom of the News & Events tab.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of press information
rubrics_metrics.description: All Redskins press releases and weekly media packets are distributed via e-mail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the Redskins Public Relations department to be added to the team’s email distribution list for all press releases and media advisories. Media can also access league press info at www.nflcommunications.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media workroom availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The media workroom at Inova Sports Performance Center at Redskins Park is located inside the annex building adjacent to the main entrance and is available to working media throughout the week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phones, rosters, transcripts and other information will be available in this area. Upon arrival at the practice facility, go to the media workroom where a PR staff member will escort you to practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video streaming and live-broadcast prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Media availabilities, open practice sessions and other team activities on club premises may not be broadcast live by an individual or media outlet without prior approval from the Washington Redskins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes use of social media applications such as Facebook Live and Periscope among others. Prior approval is required to broadcast live from club premises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credentialing priority order
rubrics_metrics.description: The Redskins prioritize outlets in the following order: (1) Broadcast partners responsible for live broadcasts; (2) Local beat reporters who cover the team daily for large-scale local outlets; (3) Large-scale national outlets; (4) Washington, D.C. metro area community publications and stations; (5) Out-of-town community outlets on specific assignment; (6) Blogs, internet radio and other independent outlets (subject to PR discretion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These priorities guide granting credentials and are applied because of limited space at Redskins Park and FedExField.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visiting scouts credential policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for visiting scouts are handled separately in accordance with the 2019 Scouting Policy distributed to all NFL teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scout credential rules are not covered by the general media credential priorities and follow the league-distributed scouting policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season credential eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Season credentials will be reserved for organizations that provide consistent and substantial coverage of the Washington Redskins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A season media credential does not guarantee working space in media work areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily/game-by-game credential issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: With the exception of seasonally credentialed beat reporters who produce daily on-site reports, all credentials at both locations are approved and issued on a daily and/or game-by-game basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume season credential equals guaranteed daily access except for specified beat reporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transferability and proper use of passes
rubrics_metrics.description: Passes and credentials are transferable within the same media outlet for use by those serving an editorial function with proper notice and approval by Redskins Public Relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Passes used by any member of a credentialed outlet without specific editorial assignment or by non-working members are subject to revocation and will affect future credentialing decisions for that outlet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freelance credential restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Credentials will not be issued to freelance writers or photographers without a specific assignment received in writing by the assigning organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because of limited work space, freelancers must have a written assignment to receive credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online entity credential criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Credentials may be issued to online entities that are affiliated with a national or regional media organization; or to online entities that host a website that regularly and substantially reports on the NFL or the Washington Redskins and employs at least one full-time permanent employee who writes a substantial majority of material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority for these sites will be based on potential audience at the discretion of Redskins Public Relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential denial and revocation grounds
rubrics_metrics.description: Redskins personnel may deny or revoke credentials without notice for: noncompliance with priorities or guidelines; noncompliance with health, safety, or security directives; conduct reasonably believed to violate state or federal law or constitute a breach of professional ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any organization wishing to contest a denial or revocation may request a written rationale from Redskins PR and submit a written response to the Senior Vice President of Communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy modification reservation
rubrics_metrics.description: Redskins Public Relations reserves the right to change this policy at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credentialing and access rules are subject to change—media should verify current policy as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice access rules and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Wednesday-Friday practices will be open to local media who regularly cover the team for designated periods. Media must go to the media workroom and will be escorted to practice. To request a Redskins Park Media Credential, email Jessie Johnson at least one (1) day prior to scheduled visit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any media member without a Redskins Park Media Credential provided by Redskins PR will not be permitted access. NO INFORMATION FROM PRACTICE THAT MAY COMPROMISE THE TEAM’S COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE IS ALLOWED TO BE DISTRIBUTED VIA ANY MEDIA PLATFORM (examples: personnel groupings, formations, injury speculation, specific plays). Failure to comply could lead to revocation of credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coach availability and interview scheduling (head coach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Head Coach Jay Gruden will conduct a weekly news conference in the Media Interview Room and will be available after practice on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday of each game week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One-on-one requests should be sent to Tony Wyllie (wylliet@redskins.com).

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinator interview scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: Defensive Coordinator Greg Manusky will be formally available after practice on Thursdays; Offensive Coordinator Kevin O'Connell will be formally available after practice on Fridays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Zena Lewis (lewisz@redskins.com) is the primary media contact for coordinators. Requests beyond those times are evaluated case-by-case according to coaches' availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking and television truck procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: There are a limited number of season-long parking passes at FedExField for media members to purchase; media may park free at the Media Parking Lot at the Grey Lot. Television trucks providing satellite, uplink or microwave functions will be parked in Lot B1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media wishing to bring a truck to a Redskins game must contact Jeff Gillies (gilliesj@redskins.com) and Jessie Johnson (johnsonj@redskins.com) no later than Monday of that game week.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance and will call procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: The media entrance and Media Will Call are located at the South Field Tunnel by Gate B. Confirmed media must enter through the media entrance and present the appropriate game credential for admission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For security, the Redskins do not send out game-by-game credentials prior to game day; all game-day credential pickups must be at Media Will Call. A valid government-issued photo ID is required. Media Will Call opens 3.5 hours prior to kickoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wireless frequency registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All credentialed media members who will be using a wireless radio frequency device (e.g., wireless microphone, communications radio; cell phones excluded) on FedExField property must register their frequency information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the NFL Game Day Coordinator, Bill Sien (redskinsgdc@yahoo.com or 730-915-8501) no later than Tuesday of game week to register frequencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistant coach interview procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: All requests for assistants must be arranged through Redskins Public Relations with at least 24 hours notice. Position coaches are available for questions on specific players and the position group only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No position coaches should be contacted directly by telephone or email. Zena Lewis (lewisz@redskins.com) is the primary media contact for assistant coaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Player interview scheduling and locker-room rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The locker room is open to accredited media for specific interview periods—generally 45 minutes following practices on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays. One-on-one requests should be arranged through Redskins PR at least 48 hours in advance. All interviews must be conducted inside the locker room unless additional permission is granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NO B-ROLL, STILL PHOTOGRAPHY OR LIVE STREAMING IS ALLOWED INSIDE THE LOCKER ROOM. Phone interviews must be arranged through Redskins PR prior to the day of the scheduled interview. All times are subject to change without prior notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Game credential request deadlines and procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: For home games, all requests must be submitted through the team’s online credentialing system at www.redskins.com/credentials no later than 5 p.m. ET on Tuesday of that game week. For away games, requests must be emailed to Jessie Johnson and include attending media members’ name, job title, media affiliation and pick-up preference no later than 10 days in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demand for credentials is high; size and legitimacy of each outlet will be considered case-by-case and subject to PR discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: FedExField internet and game-day phone line setup
rubrics_metrics.description: FedExField features complimentary wireless internet in the press box and photo room. Media interested in setting up a game day phone line should fill out a request form obtained by emailing Jessie Johnson no later than Monday of that game week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access information will be supplied in the press box and photo room.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photographer access and sideline rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Photographers credentialed for sideline access must wear a photo vest. Sideline access is limited to photographers on assignment for recognized news organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No one except network television personnel and authorized game personnel will be admitted on the field without a camera. All field photographers must remain outside the bench areas and outside the yellow border surrounding the playing field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postgame interview and locker-room access rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Media needing to conduct post-game interviews will be given access to interview rooms and locker rooms. A Redskins PR representative will escort media down to the interview areas with four minutes remaining in the game. No interviews are allowed on or coming off the field following the game.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No B-Roll, still photography, live streaming or autographs are allowed in the locker room. Following the customary 12-minute cooling off period after the game, the locker rooms will be open to the media. Head Coach Jay Gruden will be available in the postgame interview room; additional players may be brought in thereafter. Press conferences will be shown on televisions in the press box as they occur.
